video_title: The PRESSURE Joel Embiid now faces with LeBron going to the 76ers 😯 | First Take

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors missed out on LeBron James and other top free agents
quotes.excerpt: They missed out on LeBron James this offseason, they missed out on Giannis, they missed out on Jaylen Brown.
quotes.quote: The Warriors missed out on LeBron James this offseason, they missed out on Giannis, they missed out on Jaylen Brown. Last year they missed out on Kevin Durant. When you look at the cap flexibility that the Warriors have, when you look at the draft picks, the young players that could be viewed as tradeable assets, it doesn't feel like this organization has been able to land the plane when it comes to the big fish that's out there to be gotten.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry's championship window remains open in Golden State
quotes.excerpt: I think it's still open because it's Stephen Curry. I am fine being a day too late.
quotes.quote: I think it's still open because it's Stephen Curry. I am fine being a day too late on writing Stephen Curry off because I bet you people sat here in 2022 and had the discussion about whether or not the Golden State window was closed. And then they beat the Boston Celtics in the NBA championship. They have a lot of tradeable contracts and they have a lot of draft picks. Yes, they missed out on LeBron James.

quotes.speaker: Michael Wilbon
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid faces the most pressure on the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Joel Embiid has the most pressure. LeBron's career, I don't want to hear about LeBron's legacy anymore.
quotes.quote: Joel Embiid has the most pressure. LeBron's career, I don't want to hear about LeBron's legacy anymore. That is the new thing. LeBron James, if he decided tomorrow, never mind, I'm not going to play, he goes down as one of the at worst five best players of all time, and in most people's minds in the top two or three. So LeBron, if he doesn't play, much less doesn't win.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James signed with the 76ers to win a championship
quotes.excerpt: I think LeBron James because he signed up for the pressure. Happiness means winning.
quotes.quote: I think LeBron James because he signed up for the pressure. Let me define what pressure is. It's simply this. Tim McMahon on the Hoop Collective podcast says something that I think is brilliant about the 76ers organization. It's Joel Embiid's organization, it's Tyrese Maxey's team. That's what Tim McMahon says. Let me add one. I think it's LeBron James's season. I think he signed up to go to Philly because now we learn the big reveal of the end of the movie or the TV show, what does happiness mean? Happiness means winning.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's injury history makes it difficult to assign pressure
quotes.excerpt: How can you account for a guy who can't play because he's hurt? This is the nature.
quotes.quote: The 76ers played 11 playoff games this spring. He missed four of them. Three of them were because he had an appendectomy. He comes back from an appendectomy before the doctors were going to clear him. He has a 34-point game seven in one of the great games of his career to carry them over the Celtics and a few days later misses a game with a sore ankle. Because this is who Joel Embiid is. You can say that there's pressure on him, but you're never going to be able to account for the injuries. How can you account for a guy who can't play because he's hurt? This is just the nature of it.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid is synonymous with a 'trust the process' loser mentality
quotes.excerpt: Joel Embiid is synonymous with trust the process in a loser's mentality.
quotes.quote: Joel Embiid has underwhelmed in terms of the expectations that have been placed on him since he arrived in Philadelphia, and even though he got an MVP once upon a time, Joel Embiid is synonymous with trust the process in a loser's mentality. Fair or unfair, that's the label, that's the headline for his career. And so when it comes to the pressure, if you're looking at the situation in Philadelphia, Joel Embiid, if he can't win now, if he can't get to a conference finals or better now, it's probably not going to ever happen with the Philadelphia 76ers.
